about: The non-pet parts of the System Map (system-map-20261012.html): AI models, infrastructure, programs, computers and roadmap pets, plus links that cannot live in pets.json relations because one end is not a pet with a repo. Pet-to-pet links stay in pets.json relations. @pets means every registered and pipeline pet; @seeds and @roadmap mean every seed and every roadmap pet. Links to @pets reach every pet and drawn behind their own toggle. Built by scripts/system-map-20261012.mjs during npm run build. Rings say where a thing lives; access.grants say who may read, write or run it, and whether that is enforced, written only or planned (Astra, 2026-10-17). Pet program names come from pet-programs.json through each node's program number. Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5), 2026-10-12. Each node has a layer from Astra's architecture chart (0 development, 1 You, 2 Program Manager and Pet Directory, 3 Friendly Farmer, 4 pet agents, 5 AI harness, 6 real programs); each link's colour is the layer it belongs to, worked out in scripts/system-map-20261012.mjs.

nodes.name: The Farm
nodes.job: The Friendly Farmer’s pet program (pet-program-1) and the core of Astra’s PetOS, ring 0: the native home where your pets live and run, organized by the Farmer. It holds the Pet Directory and Program Manager, and its tools are the System Map and Startup Star. Astra’s PetOS is a platform that runs on Windows, not an operating system. Repo: astras-pet-os today; it splits later into the-farm (the app) and astras-pet-os (registry and docs).

nodes.name: The Kennel (community lab)
nodes.job: the-kennel (findastra/the-kennel): the community lab, where other people’s pets are submitted, checked and adopted. Public and outside the harness, like a quarantine pen: a pet from the Kennel never enters anyone’s Farm until it is signed, checked and adopted by that Farm’s owner.

nodes.name: The vet-clinic (community tickets)
nodes.job: Is your pet sick? A public issue tracker on GitHub: a farmer opens a ticket (vet-clinic-ticket-NNNN) with the sick tool’s code and error, after name-eraser and the secret scan; other farmers diagnose it and may offer a cure (a code fix). One tier below Kennel-verified: every community answer carries a warning and never runs by itself; a cure goes through quarantine, a checker agent and the farm’s L4. Every ticket is logged, and cures that work for many farms become official patches (PET-PROGRAM-FRAMEWORK.md, section 10). Outside the harness, like the Kennel.

nodes.name: The Shed (community tools and tricks)
nodes.job: Public, like the Kennel but for tools and tricks made by other creators (findastra/the-shed). Everything there is untrusted until it is quarantined, checked and approved by a farm’s L4. Trust tiers: official, Shed-verified, community (with a warning). Outside the harness.

nodes.name: Program Manager
nodes.job: Neutral registry of every real program: links, launchers, status and capabilities, for every pet including the Farmer (ASTRAS_PET_OS section 6).

nodes.name: Agent harness
nodes.job: The glass between the animals (rings 0 to 3) and everything else. Claude Code and Codex are drawn as rings around their farmhand (Claude, OpenAI): an agent can go through a ring or call the model straight. The glass marks where the rules change; it is not a sandbox: what an agent may do is in the grants on each card. Each pet's own L3 agent will use the same design: model adapters, skills and tools, memory, scheduler, inbox and permissions (ASTRAS_PET_OS sections 7 and 8, planned).

What each level should be (R W X) and whether that is in code (In code, Rule only or Not built) is shown on every map card and in every pet program's R W X panel; every In code names its evidence, which the build checks (Astra, 2026-10-19, option C). R W X lives on grants, never on a ring. Each grant names who, on what, R W X and a status; gaps point at PROTECTION-RINGS.md, Known gaps. Selectors: * (everything), ring:N, animal:N (the animals on ring N), type:T, id:X, self (the subject's own repo and data folder). A grant whose R, W and X are all no is shown only on its subject's card. level says who holds the grant, in L1 to L4 (INTELLIGENCE-LEVELS.md): L4 you, L3 an AI agent in a seat, L2 a pet program, L1 its programs and tools, which act with their pet's grants and never more; empty for the adviser and other farms, which are outside your levels. Every map card shows L1 to L4 down the left, each with the R W X it has on that thing (Astra, 2026-10-18). Every System Map card lists the grants that reach it, and npm run build writes the same list into PROTECTION-RINGS.md.
